steps.title: Admitted lines
steps.body: чита́л — read. чита́ла — read.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Admitted instruction
steps.body: For a regular verb, the past tense removes -ть and adds -л, with gender endings. Irregulars such as идти and the past of быть are outside that recipe and must be learned as listed forms.

steps.title: Remediation

steps.title: Admitted lines
steps.body: In the singular, a past-tense verb agrees with its subject in gender. In this recorded set, прочита́л is masculine, прочита́ла feminine, and прочита́ло neuter. Compare the endings while keeping the same verb.

steps.title: Admitted instruction
steps.body: Use the gender requested in the question. The pronoun I does not select one past-tense gender for every speaker. Compare the entire recorded forms: прочита́л, прочита́ла and прочита́ло. These are masculine, feminine and neuter singular forms of the same verb, respectively.

steps.title: Admitted lines
steps.body: The recorded feminine singular past form is прочита́ла. Compare its ending with the masculine прочита́л and neuter прочита́ло forms of the same verb.

steps.body:

items.prompt: Which admitted row is the feminine past?
items.feedback: чита́ла is the feminine past form for a singular subject of the verb meaning to read. чита́ло is neuter singular and чита́ли is plural. The past form matches the subject in gender and number; choose feminine singular for this question.
distractorRationales: чита́ло is neuter singular past, not feminine singular.
чита́ли is plural past, not feminine singular.

distractorDifference: чита́ло is neuter singular past, not feminine singular.
чита́ли is plural past, not feminine singular.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: чита́ла is the feminine past form for a singular subject of the verb meaning to read. чита́ло is neuter singular and чита́ли is plural. The past form matches the subject in gender and number; choose feminine singular for this question.

items.prompt: Which admitted row is the masculine past?
items.feedback: чита́л is the masculine past form for a singular subject of the verb meaning to read. чита́ли is plural past. The cue shows the feminine singular form, but the question asks for masculine singular of the same verb.
distractorRationales: чита́ли is plural past, not masculine singular.

distractorDifference: чита́ли is plural past, not masculine singular.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: чита́л is the masculine past form for a singular subject of the verb meaning to read. чита́ли is plural past. The cue shows the feminine singular form, but the question asks for masculine singular of the same verb.

items.prompt: Which admitted line is the feminine past?
items.feedback: Она чита́ла means she was reading: the feminine singular subject matches the feminine past verb. Они чита́ли means they were reading and uses plural agreement. The question asks for the feminine singular line, not the plural line.
distractorRationales: Они чита́ли has a plural subject and plural past verb, rather than feminine singular agreement.

distractorDifference: Они чита́ли has a plural subject and plural past verb, rather than feminine singular agreement.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: Она чита́ла means she was reading: the feminine singular subject matches the feminine past verb. Они чита́ли means they were reading and uses plural agreement. The question asks for the feminine singular line, not the plural line.

items.prompt: Which admitted row is the feminine past?

distractorRationales: бы́ло is neuter singular past, not feminine singular.
бы́ли is plural past, not feminine singular.

assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: была́ is the feminine past form for a singular subject meaning was. бы́ло is neuter singular and бы́ли is plural. Choose the past form with the feminine singular agreement requested here.

items.prompt: Which admitted row is the plural past?
items.feedback: бы́ли is the plural past form meaning were. бы́л is masculine singular past. The cue shows feminine singular, but the requested row is plural; past agreement follows the subject number.
distractorRationales: бы́л is masculine singular past, not the plural past requested here.

distractorDifference: бы́л is masculine singular past, not the plural past requested here.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: бы́ли is the plural past form meaning were. бы́л is masculine singular past. The cue shows feminine singular, but the requested row is plural; past agreement follows the subject number.

items.prompt: Which admitted row is the plural past?
items.feedback: бы́ли is the plural past form meaning were. бы́л is masculine singular past. The cue shows neuter singular, but the question asks for the plural form of the same verb.
distractorRationales: бы́л is masculine singular past, not the plural past requested here.

distractorDifference: бы́л is masculine singular past, not the plural past requested here.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: бы́ли is the plural past form meaning were. бы́л is masculine singular past. The cue shows neuter singular, but the question asks for the plural form of the same verb.

items.prompt: Which admitted row is the feminine past?
items.feedback: улыба́лась is the feminine past form for a singular subject of the verb meaning to smile. улыба́лись is plural past, while улыба́ться is the infinitive, not a past form. The reflexive ending remains on the past verb; choose feminine singular agreement.
distractorRationales: улыба́лись is plural past, not feminine singular.
улыба́ться is the infinitive meaning to smile, not a past-tense form.

distractorDifference: улыба́лись is plural past, not feminine singular.
улыба́ться is the infinitive meaning to smile, not a past-tense form.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: улыба́лась is the feminine past form for a singular subject of the verb meaning to smile. улыба́лись is plural past, while улыба́ться is the infinitive, not a past form. The reflexive ending remains on the past verb; choose feminine singular agreement.

items.prompt: Which admitted line is the feminine past?
items.feedback: Она улыба́лась means she was smiling, with feminine past agreement between the singular subject and verb. Они улыба́лись means they were smiling and has plural agreement. Both verbs keep their reflexive ending, but only the first line is feminine singular.
distractorRationales: Они улыба́лись has a plural subject and plural past verb, rather than feminine singular agreement.

distractorDifference: Они улыба́лись has a plural subject and plural past verb, rather than feminine singular agreement.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: Она улыба́лась means she was smiling, with feminine past agreement between the singular subject and verb. Они улыба́лись means they were smiling and has plural agreement. Both verbs keep their reflexive ending, but only the first line is feminine singular.
